nodes.question: What is the main focus of the paper regarding REDD + projects in developing countries?
nodes.answer: The paper focuses on understanding how the dynamics of developing countries' contexts affect the drivers shaping the initiation of REDD + collaborative regimes, specifically through the case study of Ghana's Cocoa Forest REDD +Programme.
